Definition: to dash to pieces, or scatter
BiblicalUsage: 1) to shatter, break, dash, beat in pieces; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to shatter; 1a2) shattering (infinitive); 1b) (Piel) to dash to pieces; 1c) (Pual) to pulverise; 2) to scatter, disperse, overspread, be scattered; 2a) (Qal); 2a1) to be scattered; 2a2) dispersed (participle)
